problem: Resident plugin-registration observer blocked opening a FIFO manifest before regular-file validation.
A child directory descriptor was not registered for finally cleanup until after metadata validation, leaking it when fstat/stat failed.
change: Open manifest with O_NONBLOCK. Register each acquired child before inspecting metadata, and remove the redundant manual close so the existing finally owns cleanup. Preserve path/owner/mode/generation/version checks.

predecessor.failure: No-writer FIFO child timeout and descriptor-count mismatch at four directory components for fstat/stat OSError and KeyboardInterrupt. Other new controls passed.

test_scope: Six new methods execute the imported actual helper in subprocesses with private files; four unchanged original tests cover exact valid manifest, symlink/absence, hierarchy swap, pre-ownership stop and pre-pulse stop. Faults are injected, not real device failures.

limits: No guarantee for arbitrary asynchronous interruption between acquisition and ownership registration, allocation failure or close failure.
O_NONBLOCK does not bound regular-file/storage latency.
No installed daemon qualification, historical recall-timeout diagnosis, full static compliance or whole-system assurance.
All original proof, continuity, recovery, installation and release gates remain binding.
